name: American Magic
aliases: New York Yacht Club American Magic
note: US sailing syndicate listed as an Official Partner of the ROCKWOOL Racing SailGP Team on SailGP's team page (fetched 2026-10-03). Since February 2026 American Magic also owns and operates the Danish team, acquired from SailGP by co-founder Doug DeVos (americanmagic.com, 2026-02-12: https://www.americanmagic.com/en/news/219_American-Magic-Acquires-Danish-ROCKWOOL-Racing-SailGP-Team-in-Landmark-Deal.html). Ownership (reported principals include Doug DeVos) not traced from a primary source in this pass.
